summary: The main article describes a visible light-enabled [4+2] photocycloaddition to synthesize anthracenone-furans. It includes 4 tables detailing optimization and substrate scope for various quinones and benzofurans, and 3 schemes illustrating synthetic approaches, specific side-product management, and the proposed reaction mechanism.

items.heading: Scheme 1. Synthetic approaches to anthracenone-furans.
items.description: Compares previous synthetic methods (Claisen rearrangement, Diels-Alder/oxidation, UV photocycloaddition) with the current visible light-mediated [4+2] annulation strategy.

items.heading: Table 1. Condition screening for annulation reaction
items.description: Optimization of photocatalysts, solvents, and light sources for the reaction between 2,3-dibromonaphthoquinone and 3-phenylbenzofuran.

items.heading: Table 2. Scope of 3-phenylbenzofurans (2)
items.description: Exploration of the substrate scope using various substituted 3-phenylbenzofurans to produce anthracenone-furan derivatives.

items.heading: Scheme 2. Synthesis of anthracenone-furan 5a.
items.description: Shows the formation of both the desired annulated product and an oxetane side product, and the use of SnCl4 to favor the annulated product.

items.heading: Table 3. Scope of 2-phenylbenzofurans (4)
items.description: Substrate scope for 2-phenylbenzofurans using SnCl4 as a Lewis acid additive to improve yields.

items.heading: Table 4. The Scope of quinones
items.description: Demonstrates the reaction scope with different polycyclic dibromoquinones to form larger fused ring systems.

items.heading: Scheme 3. Proposed mechanism.
items.description: Illustrates the triplet-triplet energy transfer mechanism, biradical intermediates, and the role of SnCl4 in the elimination and retro-Paternò-Büchi steps.
